user.title: Household power
user.description: Select total household consumption in W or kW. At 11 kW or above, Base Layer turns off the highest-drawing eligible switch and repeats until below 11 kW.

device.title: Eligible device
device.description: Select a switch Base Layer may turn off and its individual power sensor. Devices stay off until manually restarted.

error.invalid_power: Select a power sensor measured in W or kW.
error.duplicate_device: Use a distinct device meter and switch; do not select the household meter.

abort.already_configured: Base Layer is already configured. Remove it before replacing its device selection.
